datasets.description: Mozambique Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mozambique_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Mozambique to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data. Survey results were spatially mapped and classified into IPC scenarios representing different food insecurity severity phases, then distributed as geographic data (GeoJSON/KML) for medium-term projections throughout 2021.
